**[[Shah Cheragh massacre]]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Inflation]] in [[Australia]] reaches a 32-year record high amid increasing energy prices and higher [[interest rate]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/oct/26/australias-inflation-rate-hits-73-the-highest-in-since-1990-heaping-pressure-on-households (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus|2022 boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[Mercedes-Benz]] withdraws from [[Russia]] due to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]] and plans to sell shares in its [[subsidiaries]] to a local investor. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63399179 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Poland–Russia relations]]
**The [[Senate of Poland|Polish Senate]] approves a resolution formally recognizing the [[Government of Russia|Russian government]] under [[Vladimir Putin]] as a "terrorist regime". [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3601675-polands-senate-recognizes-russian-government-as-terrorist-regime.html (Ukrinform)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in Germany]]
**[[government of Germany|Lawmakers in Germany]] draft a plan to [[Legality of cannabis|legalize]] the [[Recreational drug use|recreational use]] of small amounts of [[cannabis]], pending formal approval by the [[Bundestag]] in 2024. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/germany-agrees-plan-to-legalise-recreational-cannabis/ar-AA13oEm7?OCID=ansmsnnews11 (AFP via MSN News)]
*[[Waukesha Christmas parade attack]]
**Darrell Brooks is found guilty of all [[Criminal charge|charges]] in the November 2021 attack in [[Waukesha, Wisconsin]], United States, that killed six people and injured 62 others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-63402243 (BBC News)]
*[[Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot]]
**A [[jury]] in [[Michigan]], United States, issues guilty verdicts for three men who aided in the foiled plot to [[kidnap]] [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/michigan-jury-finds-three-men-guilty-plot-kidnap-governor-2022-10-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Same-sex marriage in Mexico]]
**The [[Congress of Tamaulipas]] approves of legislation legalizing [[same-sex marriage]], making [[Tamaulipas]] the last [[Mexican state]] to do so. The [[Same-sex union legislation|legislation]] in Tamaulipas, as well as similar legislation in [[Edomex]], [[Tabasco]], and [[Guerrero]], await their signing into law. [https://news.yahoo.com/final-mexican-state-approves-same-015915473.html (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Prompt Global Strike]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces]] successfully conducts a test of its [[Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon]] off the coast of [[Virginia]] ahead of the missile's expected deployment in 2023. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/pentagon-successfully-flight-tests-hypersonic-weapon-components-2022-10-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Audi]] confirms that they will compete in [[Formula One]] races beginning in the 2026 season, after they agreed to partner with Swiss-based [[Sauber Motorsport|Sauber]], who have been involved in the sport since 1993 and currently compete under the name of [[Alfa Romeo in Formula One|Alfa Romeo]] with [[Scuderia Ferrari|Ferrari]] engines. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/26/audi-confirm-sauber-deal-to-join-formula-one-grid-from-2026-season (Reuters via ''The Guardian'')]
